blocks.text: Psalms 17 contains 15 verses. It opens with: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips. It concludes with: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with `beholding' thy form.
